blocks.title: Big O notation
blocks.text: Big O notation time complexity bayan karne ka riyazi tareeqa hai. Yeh input size barhne par algorithm ke waqt ki oopri had batata hai, ta ke algorithms ka muwazna ho sake.

blocks.caption: Aam time complexities
rows: constant: n ke saath nahi badalta
array ki cheez index se parhna
1 se n tak adad, range aadhi kar ke boojhna
linear: n ke saath barabar barhta
n IDs ek ek kar ke dekh kar student dhoondna
quadratic: n ke murabbe ke saath
n students ke har jore ka muwazna, n(n - 1)/2 muwazne

blocks.text: O(n) ki bad-tareen soorat mein matlooba student list mein bilkul aakhri hota hai, to tamam n dekhne parte hain. Boojhne ke khel mein har jawab 'zyada' ya 'kam' range aadhi kar deta hai, to andazon ki tadaad aadha karne ki tadaad, taqreeban log2 n, hoti hai. Constant time O(1) waqt aur input size ke graph par ufqi line ki tarah nazar aata hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: Venn diagram jis mein P ka daira bare NP oval ke andar, daen taraf NP-hard oval NP par charha hua, aur mushtarak hissa NP-complete, sorting, Sudoku, knapsack aur TSP ki misalon aur hal-pazeer aur tractable masail ke notes ke saath. Daen: input size ke muqable mein waqt ke khaake: O(1) seedha ufqi, O(log n) aahista barhta, O(n) seedhi line aur O(n^2) tezi se oopar murta, misalon ke saath.
blocks.caption: Complexity classes aur Big O growth (topics 3.3 aur 3.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: P, yaani jaldi hal hone wale masail jaise sorting, NP ke andar hai, yaani woh masail jin ka diya gaya hal jaldi jaancha ja sake jaise Sudoku. NP-hard masail jaise Travelling Salesman Problem kam az kam NP ke sab se mushkil masail jitne mushkil hain, aur NP aur NP-hard ka mushtarak hissa NP-complete hai, maslan knapsack masla; tasveer farz karti hai ke P NP ke barabar nahi, jo saabit nahi hua. Graph par O(1) ki line seedhi ufqi rehti, O(log n) aahista barhti, O(n) seedhi line mein barhti aur O(n^2) tezi se oopar murti hai, to bare inputs par quadratic algorithm baqiyon se kahin sust ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: 1,000 students ke liye aadha karne wale khel mein taqreeban kitne andaze, aur O(n^2) kaam mein kitne jore ke muwazne chahiyein?
blocks.explanation: Taqreeban 10 andaze, kyunke 2^10 = 1024; aur 1000 x 999 / 2 = 499,500 muwazne.

items: Big O: barhotri ki oopri had; bare n par O(1) < O(log n) < O(n) < O(n^2).
